inventory.scope_reason: The archived preprint, formal paper, captions, sections, table, and appendices were read end to end. The source archive contains TeX and rendered figure PDFs but no author numerical code or arrays. Source figures were used only to enumerate displays and read printed labels, never to trace curves, fit untabulated parameters, or generate scientific data.
